mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decrease in INDPRO (industrial output) indicates stagflationary conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% for 3 consecutive months) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential demand that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where HOUST increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profit margins and triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected 5-day increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals sudden monetary tightening that causes immediate equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS increases over 5 days, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current housing starts level below 500.0 thousand units signals residential market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
